properties.notes: Redevelopment of former hospital site for 375 dwellings underway and due to completed in 2024/25 (14/02750/FUL). Part brownfield and part greenfield land. Brownfield element (c.6ha) represents around one-third of the site area - a yield of around 124 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 3397) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 19.8ha. Alongside the residential development, the scheme also includes a wide variety of supporting infrastructure, services and facilities.
